headline: Missituk Elementary feasibility study and Roberts Elementary ARP project application, plus a $250 donation to Medford High School DECA Club.
summary: The meeting covers the Missituk Elementary feasibility study and a Roberts Elementary CM-R application for an ARP project. It also includes a before and after school update and a quarterly finance update.
items: Consent agenda: approval of bills and payrolls
Consent agenda: $250 donation from Zelus Consulting Group to Medford High School DECA Club
Consent agenda: Shore Collaborative Newsletter quarterly update
Before and after school program update, presented by Kaytie Dowcett
Missituk Elementary feasibility study, presented by Kenneth Lord
Roberts Elementary CM-R application for ARP project, presented by Kenneth Lord
Quarterly finance update, presented by Noel Velez
Presentations of the Student Advisory Council
Presentations of the public, not to begin before 7:00 pm
Condolences to the family of Arvin 'Butch' Halliday
location: Howard Alden Memorial Chambers, Medford City Hall, and via remote participation (Zoom)
